steps: Go to the official Truist offer page https://www.truist.com/checking/open-checking and confirm the $500 offer is still live.
Choose your checking account (One, Confidence, or One Advantage) and read the promo's exact qualifying activities and minimum opening deposit at application time.
Open the new personal checking account through the offer page with the promo applied, funding at least the minimum opening deposit.
Complete the promo's stated qualifying activities within the stated window (note what counts — e.g., direct deposits — before you start).
Keep the account open, unrestricted, with at least $0.01 until the bonus is paid — within 10 business days after requirements are met and verified.
To avoid monthly fees, meet the fee waiver for your account (e.g., direct deposits or minimum balance) or pick the account with the lowest waivable fee.
